title: Physiological Brain Atlas Development
brief_summary: Enrollment of candidates undergoing a deep brain stimulator (DBS) implant.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any patient between the age of 7-90
* Patients who have undergone deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery as standard of care at The Ohio State University

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: All patients who are undergoing DBS implantation surgery at the Ohio State University.
